notes.title: Bots mode update
notes.content: This is to let everyone know that bots are now available.

notes.title: V2.06
notes.content:
This is pretty big update. Meet the bots mode. As always a lot of improvements have been done. We think we got servers update list working correct this time.
Also we need to plan our next moves. What do you want to see in next update? Maybe it will be update with drones or you need more gore content. Do you want rpg elements to be added? Or shoud we just add more characters and weapons? Anyway if you find any bug, or you have any feedback, reporting it would be really apriciated. Feel free to join discord or reaching us out via email

notes.title: V2.05 Bugfix
notes.content: This is pre bots update. Made server view page look appropriate and fixed a bug there servers might not be shown. Also added a new bug where servers might duplicate. Added new feature where after player death body will not disappear until max body count reaches its maximum. Shotgun has now 2 more pellets in its bullet.

notes.title: V2.03 Bugfix
notes.content: Bugfixes. Also made online player counter work faster.
